manifest.claim_text: Typed, source-native fusion is preferable to naive resampling.
manifest.falsified_by: No reproducible gain over single-modality or carefully tuned resampling baselines; increased overconfidence or negative transfer.
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Retain only the provenance/type system; narrow or remove the shared latent fusion claim.
non_goals: This gate does not claim a validated digital twin of any specific person.
This gate does not claim that any admitted operator is neurally realized.
No prospective human TMS/tFUS protocol is implemented or implied (build order stops at item 5; item 6 is out of scope: no IRB, no consent, no participants).
